title: `exec format error` when running other arches
body:
### Issue Description

I am using podman that was installed with podman desktop (6.0.2) after upgrading from 5.x

This version of podman doesn't seem to run any emulated containers anymore (see below). I've also tried recreating the podman machine from scratch and it's the same results.

arm64 and amd64 work:

```
$ podman run --rm --platform linux/arm64 alpine uname -a
Resolved "alpine" as an alias (/usr/share/containers/registries.conf.d/000-shortnames.conf)
Trying to pull docker.io/library/alpine:latest...
Getting image source signatures
Copying blob sha256:5de55e5ef9c033997441461efe7ba23a986db059c0bb78b38f84ee0d72b99167
Copying config sha256:1991bd789d7184290c3cce84fd6af068b8b745e9bddf178661ce7f5ecf68135c
Writing manifest to image destination
Linux 58a87c53f1f7 7.1.3-200.fc44.aarch64 #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Sat Jul  4 19:23:52 UTC 2026 aarch64 Linux

$ podman run --rm --platform linux/amd64 alpine uname -a
Resolved "alpine" as an alias (/usr/share/containers/registries.conf.d/000-shortnames.conf)
Trying to pull docker.io/library/alpine:latest...
Getting image source signatures
Copying blob sha256:55afa1ecc21d2bb5e5045f32dafee56272ffd89860bac26f6c32123439af26a4
Copying config sha256:d529dd0c6e5597ac7e4a3e2dea65c3fcc6173f4cae713c409265c1dd9914a11b
Writing manifest to image destination
Linux 4d01cfdd927f 7.1.3-200.fc44.aarch64 #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Sat Jul  4 19:23:52 UTC 2026 x86_64 Linux
```

but, for example, s390x and ppc64le don't work:

```
$ podman run --rm --platform linux/s390x alpine uname -a
Resolved "alpine" as an alias (/usr/share/containers/registries.conf.d/000-shortnames.conf)
Trying to pull docker.io/library/alpine:latest...
Getting image source signatures
Copying blob sha256:da43be6afaaa3ec1b607461ce64380942a6d76c3d52cda4337b0770d9a96fa89
Copying config sha256:53a435251c38853736125131fc838f2d501ee8e9447e02830ef3e5e905eb12c0
Writing manifest to image destination
{
  "msg": "exec container process `\/bin\/uname`: Exec format error",
  "level": "error",
  "time": "2026-08-31T18:57:55.811772Z"
}

$ podman run --rm --platform linux/ppc64le alpine uname -a
Resolved "alpine" as an alias (/usr/share/containers/registries.conf.d/000-shortnames.conf)
Trying to pull docker.io/library/alpine:latest...
Getting image source signatures
Copying blob sha256:3ebcdcd395ccee658b9200e4b27d7699e5d6ed9f6c1858dea12781aac519ff59
Copying config sha256:f0f14f21e60ad9948c2aeb06895312647c1937d5ebc415a4c37ca8526532a2a3
Writing manifest to image destination
{
  "msg": "exec container process `\/bin\/uname`: Exec format error",
  "level": "error",
  "time": "2026-08-31T18:58:02.796969Z"
}
```

qemu-user-static looks like it's already installed, but I've tried older tricks such as 
https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/issues/27364#issuecomment-3549067472, and all it seems to do is break the rpm-ostreed service.

I've also tried the tried and true `podman run --rm --privileged tonistiigi/binfmt --install all`, and while that appears to complete, it doesn't work. I assume the bootc readonly fs is somehow contributing here.

### Steps to reproduce the issue

Steps to reproduce the issue
1. Create a podman machine on macOS (I used `podman machine init --cpus 6 --memory 8192 --disk-size 150 --now`)
2. `podman run --rm --platform linux/s390x alpine uname -a`

### Describe the results you received

```json
{
  "msg": "exec container process `\/bin\/uname`: Exec format error",
  "level": "error",
  "time": "2026-08-31T18:57:55.811772Z"
}
```

### Describe the results you expected

The output of `uname -a` from that container.

None

### Upstream Latest Release

No

### Additional environment details

via podman-desktop 1.29.1
macOS 15.7.8 on Apple M1 Max

### Additional information

I do see that in podman info it says

```
  emulatedArchitectures:
  - linux/386
  - linux/amd64
  - linux/arm64be
```

but my problem is all the usual ways to get the emulation added don't see to work.
